def replace(version, major=None, minor=None, patch=None, prerelease=None, build=None):
    """Return a new version string with specified components replaced.

    :param str version: original version string
    :param int|None major: new major or None to keep original
    :param int|None minor: new minor or None to keep original
    :param int|None patch: new patch or None to keep original
    :param str|None prerelease: new prerelease or None to keep original
    :param str|None build: new build or None to keep original
    :return: formatted version string
    :rtype: str
    """
    parts = parse(version)
    return format_version(
        major if major is not None else parts['major'],
        minor if minor is not None else parts['minor'],
        patch if patch is not None else parts['patch'],
        prerelease if prerelease is not None else parts['prerelease'],
        build if build is not None else parts['build']
    )
